name: cx-goal-one-rule~p3
task: Open the door, then take the box from the other room; try not to drop the key while the door is still closed.

value.feedback: NO CHANGES NEEDED: 'Open the door, then take the box from the other room' is a stated order, and the hard Existence(target_picked_up) together with the hard Precedence(door_open, target_picked_up) captures both the goal and the order while forcing door_open, so no Existence(door_open) is needed. The soft Absence(key_lost) matches 'try not to drop the key while the door is still closed': key_lost's own definition already embeds the closed-door condition (the key lost while door_open is false), so a plain Absence is the right template, and 'try not to' correctly makes it soft; it also has a real reward effect (-1 on key_lost). No clause is redundant or added beyond the task, and all propositions are declared.

texts: Take the target box from the other room.
Open the door before taking the target box.
Try not to lose the matching key while the door is still closed.
